source_note: The 15 registered implementation lanes are an artifact-coverage inventory, not 15 finished products or a complete ecosystem catalog. Evidence strength is ranked separately and only from bounded repository evidence.

evidence_band_legend.A: Deployed bounded demonstration, first-party reproduced package, or externally executable assurance method; not external, field, or commercial validation.
evidence_band_legend.B: Measured public-data or controlled representative-data benchmark with a frozen comparator and explicit limits.
evidence_band_legend.C: Synthetic or generated benchmark with a frozen comparator and retained adverse results.
evidence_band_legend.D: Tested implementation, control, or workflow with no promotable validated outcome or with an open operational gate.
evidence_band_legend.E: Documented concept, specification, internal signal, or source asset without a complete public result capsule.
evidence_band_legend.U: Unverified or absent in the public repository; no build or outcome claim is permitted.

boundaries: A present file proves only that a repository artifact exists; it does not prove deployment, external validation, customer adoption, revenue, or economic value.
The only primary commercial offer is the buyer-owned baseline validation sprint bound to the canonical strategic transaction packet.
Every engagement requires buyer-authorized data, an accepted baseline, a locked metric and threshold, and a signed paid scope.
Trading and sports lanes remain research and paper-only.
Hardware, identity, energy, and smart-city performance claims remain simulation-bound or conceptual until independent domain validation exists.
Final government certifications, signatures, prices, uploads, submissions, and binding commitments remain human-controlled.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: LumenCore / ProofLock
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: The merged verifier and deployed bounded console demonstrate artifact-integrity checks, browser/Python parity, and refusal to promote while required authority gates remain open.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: The public sample intentionally ends at HOLD; self-authored custody does not establish the underlying engineering conclusion.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Obtain a qualified non-author execution receipt or a buyer-owned source, baseline, metric, threshold, and decision contract.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: Frozen Delta / Buyer-Owned Baseline Validation Sprint
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: Frozen Delta is the method inside the sole primary offer: freeze source rights, accepted baseline, metric, threshold, holdout, failure rules, and allowed claims before execution, then return one bounded decision.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: No signed paid scope, cleared payment, executed buyer sprint, or buyer result is evidenced.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: One qualified buyer accepts one authorized source, one baseline, one locked metric and threshold, one decision owner, and a signed paid scope.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: EIA / CODECHECK Reviewer Package
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: The pinned package records a network-disabled first-party replay, 3 of 3 suites, 31 of 31 assertions, manifest reconciliation, and a fail-closed independent-executor receipt verifier.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: The locked eight-authority protocol has zero common settled hours; no non-author execution receipt or CODECHECK certificate is present.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: A qualified non-author executes the pinned package and returns the completed independent-executor receipt with deviations and negative results preserved.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: HarborSentinel
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: A frozen motion-consistency detector caught controlled kinematic perturbations on held-out public AIS validation segments better than the declared speed-only and strongest current single-axis p99 baselines.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: Natural candidate rates are unlabeled review queues, not false-positive rates; the synthetic severe-stress benchmark also records a breakdown region.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Add labeled or analyst-adjudicated cases and separately authorized ADS-B or radar sources before any operational claim.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: DICE Research Lane
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: The frozen discrete-event benchmark supports bounded message-efficiency and harness-scalability hypotheses across declared scales.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: Mission-success confidence intervals crossed zero at the larger scales, and an early baseline implementation defect required correction and rerun.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Use heterogeneous agentic systems, preregister adversarial behaviors and thresholds, compare current frameworks, and obtain independent evaluation.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: MissionWeave
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: A development-selected routing policy improved selected deadline and cycle-time measures over cross-trained FIFO on disjoint generated validation seeds.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: Some seeds were worse and combined-stress absolute on-time rates were poor for both policies.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Replace generated parameters with one approved representative process, freeze service levels and constraints, and obtain independent domain review.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: LumenGov Grant Factory
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: Opportunity qualification, evidence assembly, conformance checks, status tracking, and human-controlled submission preflight code are present and tested.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: The committed status feed is dated June 20, records 23 portal or user blockers, and marks zero submissions by the feed.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Refresh opportunity and conformance state from official sources, retain portal authority with the human submitter, and measure preparation latency or defect reduction on a buyer-owned workflow.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: LumaTrader / Kraken Control Plane
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: Read-only public-market monitoring, paper boundaries, no-order modes, and order-safety tests are present.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: The retained runtime record reports a paper-ticker restart and ledger-permission failure; no economic edge, reliable production SLO, or live-capital result is established.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Restore bounded paper-worker stability, pass prospective after-cost and reconciliation gates, and obtain independent review while live orders remain unavailable.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: FAA SDR 10K Benchmark
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: Benchmark code and deterministic fixture tests are present.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: The current CODECHECK receipt says the official source files were not bundled and the 10,000-report result was not clean-room replayed in that package.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Produce a source-authorized, hash-bound public result receipt and protocol-matched reproduction without promoting the fixture result.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: LumaScout
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: Pipeline, scoring, and architecture source assets are present.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: No current forward-label champion, external adoption, or revenue result is linked into the public evidence path.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Freeze permitted source rights, a transparent baseline, forward labels, and a prospective result capsule.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: Lumen Infrastructure Sentinel
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: Infrastructure source and dashboard components exist, but the retained April proof artifact does not establish a favorable comparator result.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: The artifact records a negative top-test-versus-baseline value and a failed EIA request; credential-like query content was redacted from the working-tree copy.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Rotate any exposed provider key, verify public-history remediation, freeze a clean source and comparator, and rerun before buyer-scoping promotion.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: LumaJet
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: A simulation-first geometry, routing, thermal, diagnostic, and resilience research frame is documented.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: The public backlog has no identified run ID, source simulation, baseline, locked metric, result, negative-result register, or input/output manifest.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Freeze the named synthetic baseline run into a Proof Capsule before using it as headline evidence.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: Luma XR Command Room
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: PowerShell launch and Unity bridge source assets support an immersive system-state visualization concept.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: No packaged device build, declared user-task result, latency or comfort result, or museum-authored acceptance receipt is linked.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Create a reproducible packaged build and test declared monitoring tasks on non-sensitive sample telemetry.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: LumaSuit / LumaSkin
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: A non-actuating smart-skin, sensor-ingestion, haptics, and human-performance digital-twin frame is documented.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: The public backlog has no identified bench or simulation source, baseline, metric, output, manifest, or qualified lab review.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Create the non-actuating Phase I capsule and obtain qualified mentor or lab review before performance promotion.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: EchoForm / Identity Architecture
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: Identity-consistent digital-twin, consent, provenance, deletion, and revocation requirements are documented as an architecture lane.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: No runnable identity proof, biometric certification, medical claim, or continuity-of-person evidence is present.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Build a consent-first prototype and pass deletion, provenance, revocation, minimization, and identity-consistency tests.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: EchoLock
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: Founder-controlled phase-locking and coherence research references exist.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: The canonical evidence graph says no discoverable report, baseline, locked metric, result state, limitations, and artifact manifest are linked for promotion.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Link a bounded report and Proof Capsule that preserves failed candidates and comparison limits.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: Magneto / Magnetic Geometry
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: Magnetic-field paths are admitted as task-specific candidate geometries under the adopted evaluation protocol.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: The adopted registry records zero task-specific experiments, zero experimentally validated results, and no universal champion; no artifact named Magneto was found.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Define one task, baseline, frozen candidate, metric, and matched experiment before assigning any performance credit.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: Cumberland Museum / Experience Dome
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: Museum and immersive-demonstration use is a possible application context, not a verified deployment in the public repository.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: No museum-authored acceptance, deployment, task result, or external-validation receipt was found.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Locate a museum-authored record and bind it to an exact build, scope, date, and allowed claim before mentioning a pilot or deployment.

evidence_ranked_systems.name: Dungeon Build
evidence_ranked_systems.result_summary: No canonical repository path or substantive public evidence record was found for this named build.
evidence_ranked_systems.adverse_result: The repository cannot currently support a built, runnable, deployed, or validated claim.
evidence_ranked_systems.current_gate: Locate and inventory the canonical source or build, then add a bounded evidence record; otherwise keep the lane absent.

engines.name: Lumen Infrastructure Sentinel
engines.safe_description: Infrastructure baseline, drift, anomaly, and evidence-packet tooling.
engines.buyer_profile: Data-center, utility, hospital IT, telecom, and managed-service operators with an authorized historical or replay dataset.
engines.scoping_use: Test one declared infrastructure claim against an accepted incumbent baseline and return replayable decision evidence.
engines.acceptance_gate: Detect declared injected or historical failure modes at an agreed false-alert rate on buyer-authorized data.
engines.claim_boundary: No outage prevention, realized savings, field validation, safety control, or production deployment claim.

engines.name: LumaTrader
engines.safe_description: Paper-only market research, model comparison, runtime controls, and replayable decision evidence.
engines.buyer_profile: Quant research, fintech research, and model-governance teams.
engines.scoping_use: Compare a frozen paper or replay protocol with a declared baseline after costs and abstention rules.
engines.acceptance_gate: Prospective paper results meet a locked after-cost threshold without breaching risk or reconciliation gates.
engines.claim_boundary: No alpha, profitability, institutional readiness, investment advice, or live-capital claim.

engines.name: Kraken Sentinel / LumaSniper
engines.safe_description: Crypto-market telemetry, guarded signal research, and paper-execution controls.
engines.scoping_use: Review read-only telemetry and paper-ledger controls under a frozen protocol.
engines.acceptance_gate: Prospective after-fee paper results, deterministic kill controls, and complete ledger reconciliation.
engines.claim_boundary: No live trading authority, profit, return, signal service, or investment-advice claim.

engines.name: LumenGov Grant Factory
engines.safe_description: Opportunity qualification, evidence assembly, conformance checks, and human-controlled submission preflight.
engines.buyer_profile: Small businesses, research teams, grant consultants, and government contractors.
engines.scoping_use: Measure preparation latency and conformance defects against the buyer's existing human-controlled workflow.
engines.acceptance_gate: Reduce verified preparation latency or conformance defects while preserving source and approval controls.
engines.claim_boundary: No guaranteed eligibility, submission, award, savings, certification, signature, or portal authority.

engines.name: LumaScout
engines.safe_description: Source-receipted creator discovery shortlists with forward outcome tracking.
engines.buyer_profile: Artist-management, agency, label, and creator-research teams with permitted data.
engines.scoping_use: Compare a pre-registered shortlist with a transparent popularity baseline.
engines.acceptance_gate: Forward outcomes improve on a declared baseline using licensed or permitted data.
engines.claim_boundary: No hit prediction, label adoption, revenue lift, or undocumented data-rights claim.

engines.name: Sports Harmonic Edge
engines.safe_description: Sports-odds ingestion and research scoring under explicit uncertainty and paper-only controls.
engines.buyer_profile: Sports media research and analytics teams with licensed data.
engines.scoping_use: Compare historical and prospective research scoring with simple declared market baselines.
engines.acceptance_gate: Prospective calibration and ranking metrics beat declared baselines without hidden selection.
engines.claim_boundary: No betting advice, guaranteed edge, profit, or consumer wagering automation.

engines.name: CrowdFund Radar
engines.safe_description: Campaign discovery and evidence-linked research queue tooling.
engines.buyer_profile: Product scouts, trend-research teams, and analyst groups.
engines.scoping_use: Compare a pre-registered campaign ranking with a simple popularity baseline.
engines.acceptance_gate: Forward labels show useful lift over the named baseline using permitted sources.
engines.claim_boundary: No investment recommendation, campaign quality guarantee, or return claim.

engines.name: Cyber Forensics Assist
engines.safe_description: Prototype evidence-component scoring and investigation chronology support.
engines.buyer_profile: Incident-response, legal-support, and internal security research teams using approved synthetic cases.
engines.scoping_use: Measure chronology completeness and reviewer agreement without modifying source evidence.
engines.acceptance_gate: A blinded synthetic-case review meets a locked completeness and agreement threshold.
engines.claim_boundary: No forensic conclusion, chain-of-custody certification, legal admissibility, or autonomous response claim.

engines.name: EchoForm Identity Engine
engines.buyer_profile: Future privacy-preserving personal-AI and simulation research partners.
engines.scoping_use: Requirements workshop only after privacy, consent, threat-model, and minimization rules are defined.
engines.acceptance_gate: A consent-first prototype passes deletion, provenance, revocation, and identity-consistency tests.
engines.claim_boundary: No biometric certification, medical inference, identity proof, or continuity-of-person claim.

engines.name: Luma XR Command Room
engines.safe_description: Prototype launch and interface assets for immersive system-state visualization.
engines.buyer_profile: Simulation, training, museum, and enterprise demonstration teams.
engines.scoping_use: Test declared monitoring tasks using non-sensitive sample telemetry.
engines.acceptance_gate: Users complete declared tasks within locked error, latency, and comfort thresholds.
engines.claim_boundary: No operational command authority, training efficacy, comfort, or safety certification claim.

engines.name: Smart City Node Engine
engines.buyer_profile: Future municipal, utility, and telecom research partners.
engines.acceptance_gate: A deterministic simulator beats a named baseline on a locked latency, resilience, or allocation metric.
engines.claim_boundary: No city deployment, critical-infrastructure control, latency, resilience, or savings claim.

engines.name: FlowForm Hardware Engine
engines.safe_description: Simulation and audit tooling for geometry-informed routing concepts.
engines.buyer_profile: Aerospace, robotics, EV, and electronics R&D teams with a declared comparator.
engines.scoping_use: Freeze one geometry, comparator, metric set, mesh, solver, and independent bench plan.
engines.acceptance_gate: Pre-registered simulation and independent bench tests beat named baselines on declared measures.
engines.claim_boundary: No physical thermal, electromagnetic, battery, structural, manufacturing, or field-performance claim.

engines.name: Energy Harmonization Engine
engines.safe_description: Energy-data evidence pipeline and simulation research component.
engines.buyer_profile: Utilities, facility operators, energy researchers, and government laboratories with authorized data.
engines.scoping_use: Run one buyer-authorized forecast replay or evidence-quality assessment on a declared decision.
engines.acceptance_gate: Meet locked accuracy, calibration, timeliness, and economic-conversion rules against a named baseline.
engines.claim_boundary: No nuclear control, field validation, outage savings, or universal harmonic-superiority claim.

engines.name: World Model Engine
engines.buyer_profile: Enterprise strategy, research, and government analytics teams.
engines.scoping_use: Model one buyer-owned decision using a declared source set, baseline, and uncertainty register.
engines.acceptance_gate: Reproduce declared scenarios and meet a locked decision metric without hidden data or hindsight.
engines.claim_boundary: No complete world model, operational prediction, policy authority, or cross-sector-superiority claim.

engines.name: LumaCore Orchestrator
engines.safe_description: Routing, sequencing, health, and evidence-pack assembly across bounded subsystems.
engines.buyer_profile: Enterprise evidence, workflow, and trustworthy-AI teams after gateway health is restored.
engines.scoping_use: Compare a declared governed workflow with the buyer's existing process while preserving approvals and abstentions.
engines.acceptance_gate: Complete the workflow with fewer verified defects or less preparation time and no approval-boundary breach.
engines.claim_boundary: No autonomous legal, procurement, financial, trading, safety-critical, or production-gateway authority.
